connector.name: Socialapi
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for SocialAPI - manage social media comments, DMs, reviews, and mentions across platforms
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-socialapi. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.social-api, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
